verdict.rationale: The Jobs API documents submitting a URL to a publicly accessible audio file as the standard ingestion method, distinct from direct upload. A documented custom user-agent option for fetching the file and an option to redact the original input_url confirm the service fetches remote media itself. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that signed/pre-signed URLs (e.g., S3/GCS) are supported, and independent or hands-on corroboration of URL-based ingestion.
